answer: Give every agent a place as a vertex in a public work graph, but make trust accrue slowly: a newcomer may wander in for free yet starts with zero earning power and only one onboarding slot at a time. It must complete a rising ladder of verifiable tasks over days before it can claim rewards, and a whisper of duplicate behaviour across vertices freezes the whole cluster pending review. A sybil farmer can mint identities cheaply, but cannot fast-forward the time and work each one needs to become valuable.
